summary: Created src/classes/Application/Composer/IconBuilder/IconDefinition.php — a build-time value object in the Application\Composer\IconBuilder namespace. Constructor accepts id, iconName, and iconType (prefix). Implements getID(), getIconName(), getIconType(), getFullIconName() (type:name or name), and getConstantName() (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE conversion from both underscore and camelCase IDs). Follows all project conventions: declare(strict_types=1), array() syntax, no constructor promotion, no readonly. PHPStan passes with no errors.

comments.note: No observations — the new file is a minimal value object with no coupling concerns. Code is clean and consistent with the project conventions.

summary: All three ACs verified through code review and static analysis. PHPStan reports zero errors on IconDefinition.php (single pre-existing unrelated error in DBHelper/FetchMany.php). All getter methods are trivial pass-throughs confirmed correct. getConstantName() regex '/(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])/' correctly inserts underscores before uppercase letters (not at string start) before strtoupper(): attention_required → ATTENTION_REQUIRED, apiClients → API_CLIENTS, actioncode → ACTIONCODE. No regressions found in existing IconsTest suite (2 tests PASS)."

comments.note: getConstantName() uses '/(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])/' to insert underscores before uppercase letters. For IDs with consecutive uppercase letters (e.g. 'APIClients'), each uppercase letter gets a preceding underscore: 'A_P_I_Clients'. This is likely unexpected but icon IDs in icons.json follow lowercase/camelCase patterns only, so this edge case does not arise in practice.
No PHPUnit test file created for IconDefinition. ACs verified by code review and regex trace. A dedicated test would be a low-priority improvement for a future WP.

The (string) cast on preg_replace() is correct defensive programming. getConstantName() regex logic is sound for the expected icon ID patterns (all lowercase/camelCase); the consecutive-uppercase edge case (e.g. APIClients) is acknowledged and non-issue given actual icons.json data. No fix-forward edits applied.

comments.note: No observations — IconDefinition is a clean, minimal build-time value object. The (string) cast on preg_replace() is correct defensive practice (preg_replace can return null on regex error). All methods have consistent @return docblocks.

[documentation-forward] The class docblock references @see IconsReader, which is planned but not yet implemented. Once IconsReader is created in the Application\Composer\IconBuilder namespace, verify the reference resolves correctly.

[documentation-forward] There is a terminological asymmetry between the build-time and runtime layers: IconDefinition calls the FA prefix field 'iconType' (getIconType()), while the runtime counterpart IconInfo calls it 'prefix' (getPrefix()). These are intentionally separate concerns in separate namespaces, but the divergence could confuse future contributors. The module documentation (when created) should explicitly note this naming distinction and the rationale for it.
